Description: A seed for a tree that grows delicious fruit. If planted on bare dirt, it can grow into a mighty tree.

Name: Grass Seed
Description: A seed that will grow grass when planted on bare dirt.

Description: A seed for a somewhat familiar looking tree that grows some kind of strange jiggly fruit. If planted on bare dirt, it can grow into a mighty tree.

Name: Juicy Seed
Description: A seed for a familiar looking tree that grows a strange juicy fruit. If planted on bare dirt, it can grow into a mighty tree.

Name: Ominous Seed
Description: This appears to be some kind of ominous looking seed. If planted on bare dirt, it will probably grow into... something.

Name: Orange Seed

Name: Peach Seed
Description: A seed for a peach tree. If planted on bare dirt, it can grow into a mighty tree.

Name: Sweety Seed
Description: A seed for a familiar looking tree that grows a strange sweet fruit. If planted on bare dirt, it can grow into a mighty tree.

Name: Wheat Seed
Description: If planted on bare dirt, this simple seed can grow into a large stalk of wheat.

Description: A set of salad tongs that you can use to make delicious salads.

Description: A high-tech salad tosser composed of space-age materials. It can make bigger salads.

Description: A corrosive, bubbling fluid.

Description: A colorless fluid with a noxious odor.

Description: A sharp steel blade.

Description: A crude stone dagger.

Name: Xenotech Helmet
Description: A sealed xenotech helm laced with alien circuitry. Humming softly when worn.

Name: Xenotech Legs
Description: Xenotech leg plating that distributes impact through a lattice of conduits.
